text_block_list.text:
Having safely claimed victory in the Queen Stakes,
Yukino Bijin threw herself into her training with even greater zeal.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, after this...
would it be okay if I pushed myself just a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know you're just looking out for me!
But I can't afford to rest right now...!

Still, she is already working very hard.
I understand how she feels, but piling on
any more would just be overtraining.
It seems you're in trouble!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san!
Hellooo there.

Sakura Bakushin O.
An Umamusume one generation above Yukino Bijin,
making waves in the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much
for your help the other day!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The other day at the convenience store,
I tried using one of those self-checkout things.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Turns out that place was electronic payment only...
People were waiting behind me in line, and I totally panicked!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And that's when the Class Rep made her entrance!
—I raised my hand with great energy and called the waiter over!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I was sooo relieved back then!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san has been
so kind to me ever since
I first enrolled in the academy~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Besides... it might sound strange, but you kinda remind me of my dad. Talking with ya really puts me at ease!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The Class Rep's warm embrace!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And from me too!
Thank you so much for your help the other day!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: When I Bakushin-ed too much over a long distance and couldn't move, Yukino-san carried me all the way to the nurse's office!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, no, compared to pulling a tractor out
of a rice paddy, this was a breeze, ya know?

It looks like they have a give-and-take relationship,
getting along quite well with each other.
choice_data_list: By the way, why did you call out to me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You seemed to be in trouble,
so this Class Rep thought she'd lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ya for the concern, aye!
Actually, you see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Training that doesn't push me too far into exhaustion...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
wouldn't it be best to just have fun and play?

If you choose the right way to play, it makes for good exercise.
The effect may be mild, but fatigue is hardly felt.
It should be a perfect addition.
choice_data_list: As expected of the class rep.
As expected of the class rep.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! You can leave
the menu to me too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A'ight then, please do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're right...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: How about 'Bakushin O Power Game' or 'Bakushin Scorching Hell' instead?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Both of those names are quite intriguing, aren't they!?
...I'll stop them if it gets too extreme, but I'm curious about the contents, so I decided to pick it for now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Power just has such a cool ring to it, doesn't it!
Let's get started right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"And so, let it begin!
Bakushin or Power Game!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: *clap clap clap*...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple!
When I say 'Bakushin', do a Bakushin pose,
and for 'Power', do a Power pose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whatever pose you come up with on your own is fine!
That's all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is this game...
supposed to be training...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's ask Trainer to be the judge!
Please also assign which pose each of us
has to make!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, guess it's fine.
Trainer, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, starting with Bakushin~!
The Bakushin or Power Game!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...
Come on, Trainer, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin-shiin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That calls for an inquiry right now!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh dang!
Guess I couldn't play it off!

Is this really training?
Or rather, is it even a game...?
Seeing the two of them having so much fun, I kept the question to myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're full of spirit!
Even though it's literally labeled as hell!
choice_data_list: Just to be sure... this isn't dangerous, right?
Just to be sure... this isn't dangerous, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! On my honor as class rep,
I will never harm a fellow student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Except for your mouth!
That's gonna get scalding hot!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—And so,
let the scorching hell begin!”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bakushin O-san,
what is this...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Eating piping hot food in blistering heat!
Now this is a scorching hell to test your willpower!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I see...? / Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, is this
really trainin'?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I?
This is training to build your guts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"There are countless ways to become stronger!
Put your faith in the Class Rep and you shall be saved!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aya~!
Understood!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, whoever finishes eating first wins!
Bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The steam is so hooot!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haff, haff, haff...
Dang it, it's too hot to even get close to the noodles!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Looks like this is going to turn into one incredible workout!
Still, Yukino Bijin is trying her absolute hardest. She got plenty of training in today, too. I'll just quietly pretend I didn't see anything.
